sql: WITH last AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.market_ticker) s.* FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.at > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY s.market_ticker, s.at DESC), prog AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) * FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type='liquidity' AND end_date > now() + interval '24 hours' ORDER BY market_ticker, last_seen_at DESC), j AS ( SELECT l.market_ticker mkt, l.best_yes_bid y, l.best_no_bid n, greatest(l.est_yes_score_total,1) fy, greatest(l.est_no_score_total,1) fn, p.period_reward_usd/ nullif(extract(epoch from p.end_date - p.start_date)/86400,0) pool_day, extract(epoch from p.close_time - now())/86400 close_d FROM last l JOIN prog p USING (market_ticker) WHERE l.est_yes_meets_target AND l.est_no_meets_target), k AS (SELECT *, (500/(fy+500)+500/(fn+500))/2 s500, (2000/(fy+2000)+2000/(fn+2000))/2 s2000, (5000/(fy+5000)+5000/(fn+5000))/2 s5000 FROM j) SELECT 'ALL qualifying (n='||count(*)||') median' AS row_, NULL::text px, NULL::numeric close_d, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY least(fy,fn))::numeric) field, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pool_day)::numeric,2) pool_day, round(100*percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s500)::numeric,1) sh500, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pool_day*s500)::numeric,2) day500, round(100*percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s2000)::numeric,1) sh2000, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pool_day*s2000)::numeric,2) day2000, round(100*percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s5000)::numeric,1) sh5000, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pool_day*s5000)::numeric,2) day5000 FROM k UNION ALL SELECT mkt, y||'/'||n, round(close_d::numeric), round(least(fy,fn)::numeric), round(pool_day::numeric,2), round(100*s500::numeric,1), round((pool_day*s500)::numeric,2), round(100*s2000::numeric,1), round((pool_day*s2000)::numeric,2), round(100*s5000::numeric,1), round((pool_day*s5000)::numeric,2) FROM k WHERE close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60
